title: Catch-up, by design
objective: Protected week (3–4 hrs/day). Holidays and call rotas land here. Clear the backlog; if none, consolidate weeks 7–13 and begin timed CO/CE.
tasks: List every skipped lesson/drill from weeks 1–13 and clear the top five
Begin the format shift: one timed CO and one timed CE set
Do NOT reach forward for new grammar

steps.title: Don't fill this week
steps.body:
Across four months you will have lost days to shifts, power cuts and illness. This week absorbs them.
If you genuinely have no backlog: **don't reach forward** for new grammar. Consolidate weeks 7–13 and start timed comprehension.

steps.q: You have no backlog. What do you do this week?
options: Start the week-17 B2 grammar early

items.q: Il faut que tu ___ ce document.
C'est la ville ___ je suis né.
Si on ___ plus tôt, on aurait moins de stress.
Il m'a dit qu'il ___ le lendemain.
___ je trouve inquiétant, c'est le prix.

steps.title: Timed comprehension starts
steps.body:
Go to **Gates & mocks** → take the CO section of Mock A timed (it was untimed at Gate 3). Then one CE set against the clock.
Rule: **never leave a blank** — there's no penalty for guessing.
